drawings.description: à droite de ces formules, un croquis : une région $C$ hachurée par deux familles de droites parallèles. Le signe devant $\operatorname{bnd}_D$ est bien une intersection sur la page, là où l'on attendrait une réunion
drawings.kind: region hatched by two families of parallel lines
drawings.notes: Re-read on a zoomed view: five descending and five rising straight lines (the outer ones short), each drawn once from end to end, so that every crossing of the hatching is the crossing of the lines themselves; the first descending line starts on the upper arm of the brace on the left. The faint wavy outline is drawn in its separate pieces (left loop, top arc, top right, the bottom C-shaped piece, the loop at the bottom, the bottom right wave). Still differs: the families are not quite parallel on the page and are drawn as he drew them; the small marks inside the region (four short signs, one perhaps a letter) are not read and are left out; the label C is not on the sketch (it is in the formulas). Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again. Question settled by a machine pass on the facsimile, 2026-11-12 (maths): the small signs inside the hatched region stay unread and left out: the transcription names no label there and the formulas beside the sketch already name the region C, so they add nothing to the figure (no consequence). Not checked by a reader.

drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, un croquis : une bande entre deux droites parallèles, un point marqué sur l'une, et une ligne brisée en zigzag entre les deux
drawings.kind: strip between two parallel lines with a zigzag
drawings.notes: Two nearly parallel lines bounding a strip, a marked point on the upper one (left end) with a tick to the right; from the point a broken zigzag line runs between the two lines (shape approximate).

drawings.description: à gauche, un petit croquis : quatre segments issus d'un point, dans un cercle, deux d'entre eux repassés à l'encre
drawings.kind: segments from a point inside a circle
drawings.notes: From the heavy central point five segments, all starting at that point: two inked heavily (up left, up right), three thin (down left, down, down right). Around it the circle, drawn as he drew it, in straight pieces: the left side runs from the heavy left stroke down to the down-left segment and on to the bottom, the lower right piece ends on the down-right segment, the right side starts on the heavy right stroke, and a separate piece at the top; the gaps on either side of the downward segment are his. Still differs: five segments leave the central point where the transcription says four; the circle is a polygon of pieces, not a closed round curve. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again. Question settled by a machine pass on the facsimile, 2026-11-12 (page): five segments leave the central point (two heavy ones upwards, three thin ones downwards), as drawn; the transcription's « quatre segments » is to be corrected by the transcription skill. Not checked by a reader.
drawings.disagreement: Five segments leave the central point on the facsimile (two inked heavily, three thin), not four.

drawings.description: croquis en marge gauche ; au-dessus, un premier croquis du même losange, raturé
drawings.kind: diamond x, y, y', z (Hasse diagram) with a struck first sketch
drawings.notes: The diamond in the left margin: x on the left, arrows to y' (upper) and y (lower), and from each an arrow to z on the right, labels at \small as in the tikzcd of the transcription; each arrow lies on the line between the centres of the two labels it joins. Left out, following the convention for strike-outs: the first sketch above it, heavily struck with zigzag hatching, and the horizontal stroke just above the diamond (starting at a heavy cross, with two small arrowheads and a crossed x on it), read as part of the struck first attempt. Still differs: on the page the two upper arrows run 1 to 2 units above the label-to-label lines. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.
